feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: Trump to hold rally in Alaska as campaign tour for GOP candidates continues
entry.summary: With the midterm elections just weeks away, President Trump continues his tour across the country to rally for Republican candidates, stopping Tuesday in Alaska.

entry.title: Republican strategist on how the GOP can rally voters in the midterm's final stretch
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with Republican strategist Ron Bonjean about how the low-polling party can hone its message to voters in the final few weeks before the midterms.

entry.title: Pakistan imposes emergency rule in former prime minister's stronghold
entry.summary: Pakistan has imposed emergency rule in the province governed by the political party of imprisoned former prime minister Imran Khan.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: Trump will headline a rally in Alaska Tuesday, federal agents searched Rep. Ilhan Omar's D.C. home Monday, Trump's diesel deal with Russia frustrates European leaders.

entry.title: British officials say Iran was responsible for incident at U.K. air base
entry.summary: Britain's prime minister says Iran was "almost certainly" behind last month's security incident at the US-run RAF Fairford airbase.

entry.title: In reliably red Texas, the Senate and gubernatorial races are unusually competitive
entry.summary: NPR's A Martínez asks David Martin Davies of Texas Public Radio about the state's surprisingly close U.S. Senate and governor's races.

entry.title: How Trump's immigration policies have affected a Texas border town
entry.summary: NPR's A Martínez visits a Texas border town to see how the Trump administration's immigration policies have affected it, and how people there are viewing the midterm elections.

entry.title: Researchers are tracking Monarch butterflies to learn more about their journey
entry.summary: Researchers all over North America are attaching tiny transmitters to Monarch butterflies as they begin their migration to Mexico, to learn more about their stops and challenges.

entry.title: Texas started the redistricting war. How it could shape the midterm results
entry.summary: Texas Republicans kicked off the nationwide redistricting war by redrawing several seats in the state to make them more Latino. NPR's A Martínez explores what that means for the midterm elections.

entry.title: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC home
entry.summary: Federal agents searched the Washington, D.C. home of Rep. Ilhan Omar, D-Minn., Monday morning. Omar criticized the search, calling it a weaponization of federal law enforcement.
